acceptance_criteria: Acceptance criterion 2 cannot be verified as written, and the repository cannot settle what it should say. The criterion states "No Go test reads .kiro/agents/*.md or .kiro/skills/ except the two kept tests" and verifies it with `grep -rlnE 'kiro/(agents/[a-z-]+\.md|skills/)' --include='*_test.go' internal cmd`, which must list only the files holding the kept tests. Run on the current tree, that grep also matches 14 unrelated test files that are outside the 37-test table. Twelve are in internal/eval (provenance_workflow_test.go, candidate_test.go, audit_test.go, execute_case_test.go, workspace_test.go, provenance_wire_test.go, pinning_test.go, provenance_test.go, and sandbox/container_test.go). The others are internal/inference/kirocli_test.go and the kept test file internal/planner/evaldriver_test.go. The internal/eval and internal/inference matches write fixture files with those paths into temp directories or strings. They do not read the live prompts. The grep therefore cannot pass after the 37 deletions, and the issue excludes those files from scope. The criterion also conflicts with the Context section, which says three tests stay (TestSelfTestWorkspaceCasesNative, TestEvalDriverOverlayAndResults and TestTemplatesContainNoPlannerConventionsPath), not two. Only TestEvalDriverOverlayAndResults reads a live prompt (internal/planner/evaldriver_test.go:231). TestTemplatesContainNoPlannerConventionsPath walks cmd/kairon/templates and never touches .kiro. TestSelfTestWorkspaceCasesNative skips .kiro entirely (internal/eval/sandbox_workspace_test.go). A person must edit criterion 2 in the issue to name the packages the check covers (for example only internal/planner and cmd/kairon/cmd) and the exact set of files that may remain in its output. The edit should also reconcile "two kept tests" with the three tests the Context section keeps.
